title: Minimal Forensics
description: Smallest CASE/UCO slice that still produces a validated evidence graph: one investigation, one tool-backed action, and hashed file/device observables.
mission: Get a field examiner or agent from a file listing to a SHACL-valid graph without loading CAC or upper profiles.

File.notes: One ObservableObject (or File) per real-world file. Hash lives on ContentDataFacet, never as a bare string.

recipe_skeleton.summary: Investigation + Tool + InvestigativeAction + hashed File observables.
steps: Create Investigation as the case container.
Create Tool with name and version.
For each file: ObservableObject with FileFacet + ContentDataFacet(Hash).
Link action object/result to the observables.
